verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੫ : ਜਪੁ ਜੀ ਦੇ ਸਲੋਕ ‘ਪਵਣ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤਾ’ ਦਾ ਅਰਥ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 5 : jap jee dhe salok 'pavan guroo paanee pitaa' dhaa arath

en.bdb: The meaning of the 38th stanza of japuji-pavn-Guru pani pita

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉਣ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਵਾਹਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: paun guroo gur sabadh hai vaahaguroo gur sabadh sunaiaa|

en.bdb: The Guru's word is the air, the Guru and wondrous lord has recited Word the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ੍ਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥਿ ਨਿਵਾਣਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: paanee pitaa pavitrr kar gurmukh pa(n)th nivaan chalaiaa|

en.bdb: The father of man is water which by flowing downwards teaches humility.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਮਾਤ ਮਹਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dharatee maat mahat kar ot pot sa(n)jog banaiaa|

en.bdb: The earth being tolerant like mother is the mother and is the further base of all the creatures.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਾਈ ਦਾਇਆ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਹੁ ਬਾਲ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਜਗਤੁ੍ਰ੍ਰ ਖਿਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dhaiee dhaiaa raat dhih baal subhai jagaturr khilaiaa|

en.bdb: The day and night are the nurses who keep the people of child-wisdom busy in the plays of the world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਕਾਰਥਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਸਿ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh janam sakaarathaa saadhasa(n)gat vas aap gavaiaa|

en.bdb: The life of Gurmukh is meaningful because he in the holy congregation has lost his egotism.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣ ਮਰਣਹੁ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: ja(n)man maranahu baahare jeevan mukat jugat varataiaa|

en.bdb: He becoming liberated in life behaves in the 'world with the skill to come out of the cycle of transmigration.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਹੈ ਪਿਤਾ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਮੋਖ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gurmat maataa mat hai pitaa sa(n)tokh mokh padh paiaa|

en.bdb: The mother of the gurmukhs is the wisdom of the Guru and father, the contentment through  whom they attain deliverance.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧੀਰਜੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਭਿਰਾਵ ਦੁਇ ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਪੁਤ ਜਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dheeraj dharam bhiraav dhui jap tap jat sat put janaiaa|

en.bdb: Forbearance and the sense of duty are their brothers, and meditation, austerities, continence the sons.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਪੁਰਖਹੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਚਲਤੁ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gur chelaa chelaa guroo purakhahu purakh chalat varataiaa|

en.bdb: The Guru and the disciple are diffused into one another in eternity and they both are the  extension of the perfect supreme Lord.
Raving realized the supreme pleasure they have made others also realize the same.
